pricingBasis: Publicly listed Gemini 2.5 Flash text pricing at the time of this run: ~$0.30 / 1M input tokens, ~$2.50 / 1M output tokens. Not the provider invoice.
estimateScope: The successful, correct v3 run only (results/vertex-gemini-2.5-flash-v3/*.results.jsonl).
wastedAttemptNote: A first attempt at this run (~$0.84, same token-count order of magnitude) was discarded: the datasets had not yet been regenerated with prompts/system-prompt-v3.txt embedded, so it silently re-ran v2 under a v3 label. Total actual spend across both attempts for this Group 7 re-run is therefore roughly double this file's figure (~$1.65) -- disclosed here rather than only counting the successful attempt, per this project's own honest-reporting practice.
totalCostNote: The final GCP invoice total was not captured; this is a token-based estimate.
resourcesRemovedNote: No dedicated GCP resource was created for this run; nothing project-specific to clean up.
